recommendations.description: Audit Medicaid inpatient AUTH_CODE_DISTRIBUTION mapping in CA, AR, and IN for Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC, Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC, and Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC; confirm prior authorization was obtained, validate denial enforcement, and correct claims-processing or reprocessing logic before policy action.
evidence: Flags include auth_or_mapping_shift and requires_validation_before_action.
CA accounts for +$6.2M across four inpatient DRGs.
AR adds +$1.4M from the same authorization code distribution issue.
IN adds +$1.2M, concentrated in Cirrhosis and Alcoholic Hepatitis with CC.
No admission or paid-per-admit metrics support a utilization interpretation.
peer_benchmarking: United Health policy example lists No Prior Auth for the cited service.

recommendations.description: Audit DC PA-required inpatient TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual claims at CHILDRENS HOSPITAL billed as Not Mapped or OTHER to match authorizations to actual admissions, enforce denial edits, and confirm inpatient contract bundling is adjudicating correctly before site-of-care remediation.
evidence: DC TANF Standard Not Mapped drove +$4.5M from 92 more admissions.
DC TANF Standard OTHER added +$1.3M from 57 more admissions.
DC ABD Non Dual Not Mapped added +$0.6M from 16 more admissions.
All flagged records are PA-required DC Medicaid inpatient claims.
CHILDRENS HOSPITAL repeats in drill context across flagged admissions.
peer_benchmarking: United Health bundles routine inpatient UB-04 services into facility charges; only facility-owned ventilator/CPAP management is separate.

recommendations.description: For CA Medicaid ACUTE HOSPITAL claims with pa_required_code Y in TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual, review Esophagitis, Gastroenteritis and Miscellaneous Digestive Disorders without MCC and Major Small and Large Bowel Procedures with CC to confirm prior authorization, match authorizations to billed inpatient actuals and level of care, enforce authorization denials, validate contract-based claims processing, and obtain itemized bill review for high-cost admissions.
evidence: CA TANF Standard acute hospital drove +$5.6M across digestive, bowel, cirrhosis, obesity, and nerve DRGs.
Digestive disorders added +$2.0M with more admissions and higher paid per admit.
Major bowel procedures added +$1.7M with more admissions and higher paid per admit.
All cited claims have pa_required_code Y in CA Medicaid acute hospital.
peer_benchmarking: Molina summary shows IP/OP Only setting with no documented prior auth or appeals details.

recommendations.description: Implement a CA inpatient diagnosis-targeted UM policy for ALCOHOLIC CIRRHOSIS LIVER W/ASCITES, METABOLIC SYNDROME, NONINFECTIVE GE & COLITIS UNS, and TYPE 2 DM W/DIAB AUTONOM NEUROPATHY at DEACONESS MIDTOWN HOSPITAL, FRESNO HEART & SURGICAL HOSPITAL, and SIDNEY AND LOIS ESKENAZI HOSPITAL requiring prior-authorization verification, same-diagnosis repeat-admission review with CTI discharge planning, and site-of-care review for non-ER obesity procedure stays.
evidence: CA inpatient clinical case-mix increased total paid by $5.3M.
Alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites added 66 admissions at DEACONESS MIDTOWN HOSPITAL.
Metabolic syndrome obesity procedures added 35 admissions; ER admit indicator N.
Noninfective GE and colitis added 56 admissions with higher paid per admit.
TYPE 2 DM W/DIAB AUTONOM NEUROPATHY added 31 admissions.
PA required code is Y across cited CA inpatient diagnoses.
peer_benchmarking: United Health mentions hepatic fibrosis testing for liver diseases; no inpatient DRG payment rule identified.
Humana review was off-topic laboratory A1AT testing, not an inpatient payment policy.

recommendations.description: Launch a DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC NC Medicaid inpatient payment-integrity review for pa_required_code Y admissions to correct Not Mapped facility attribution, validate authorization-to-claim matching and denial enforcement for TANF Standard and ABD Non Dual claims, perform itemized bill review for Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System with MCC cases, and then assess DUKE-specific contract or site-of-care remediation.
evidence: NC Medicaid admissions are concentrated at DUKE UNIVERSITY HEALTH SYSTEM INC.
TANF Standard Not Mapped utilization was volume-led on PA-required inpatient claims.
ABD Non Dual Not Mapped showed utilization and unit-cost pressure.
Heart Transplant or Implant of Heart Assist System with MCC created high-cost outliers.
Additional DUKE Not Mapped clinical case reinforces attribution concerns.

recommendations.description: Initiate retrospective payment-integrity review for catastrophic inpatient claims from CHILDRENS HOSPITAL, ARKANSAS CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL, and SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL, validating DRG severity coding, itemized bills, authorization compliance, and contract/outlier reimbursement for tracheostomy with prolonged ventilation, craniotomy with MCC, extensive burns with ventilation and skin graft, ECMO/tracheostomy major O.R., trauma, pneumonia, GI obstruction, and transplant admissions.
evidence: Single DC tracheostomy ventilation admission at CHILDRENS HOSPITAL added +$1.3M.
Single DC craniotomy admission at CHILDRENS HOSPITAL added +$0.7M.
ARKANSAS CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL trauma, pneumonia, and GI obstruction admissions contributed about +$1.0M.
Two SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL cases totaled about +$0.6M.
Highlighted catastrophic claims show pa_required_code Y and small_n_admissions flags.

recommendations.description: Initiate a provider-specific audit for VA Medicaid inpatient claims at SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL to correct Not Mapped facility attribution for ABD Non Dual and TANF Standard claims, confirm prior-authorization-to-claim matching and denial enforcement, and validate TANF Standard ACUTE HOSPITAL reimbursement and reprocessing against contractual obligations.
evidence: Spend increase is concentrated at SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL in VA.
ABD Non Dual Not Mapped admissions increased at SENTARA NORFOLK GENERAL HOSPITAL.
TANF Standard Not Mapped admissions increased at the same provider.
TANF Standard ACUTE HOSPITAL paid per admit increased as admissions declined.
Major source cards are prior-auth-required and flagged auth-to-claim validation.
Validation is needed because largest drivers sit in Not Mapped claims.

recommendations.description: Create a state-product authorized inpatient exception queue for MD/MO/WV TANF Standard, AR LTSS Non Dual, IN/NY Family Care, FL/OH ABD Non Dual, CO Family Care, and FL LTSS Non Dual to confirm prior authorization was obtained and matched to billed admissions, audit initial and concurrent review plus nurse and MD approval-denial pathways, and verify contractual claims processing and manual-adjudication edits.
evidence: All source cards show pa_required_code equals Y.
MD, MO, and WV TANF Standard acute hospital added +$1.1M.
AR LTSS Non Dual added in CHILDRENS, Not Mapped, and ACUTE PSYCH.
IN Family Care acute hospital added across cirrhosis and nerve disorder admissions.
NY Family Care acute hospital added from obesity procedures.
FL, OH, and CO contain smaller ABD or Family Care exceptions.
peer_benchmarking: Elevance Health requires POA on all diagnoses and excludes non-POA HCAC CC/MCCs from DRGs.
Elevance Health states HCACs can lower DRGs and reduce reimbursement or covered days.
